name: Passkey WebAuthn ceremonies
summary: Coordinate discoverable user-verified WebAuthn ceremonies around go-webauthn.
use_when: A product offers passkey register/login with durable ceremony and credential storage.
proposed_guarantees: RP ID and origins come from configuration only

evidence.basis: Ceremony consume-before-verify and configured-origin RP binding match patterns in a restricted product (ajent-social human accounts). Identifying paths are not published. No private source was copied into AMSL.

alternatives.name: go-webauthn
alternatives.assessment: Required dependency for protocol validation; AMSL owns ceremony/credential coordination.

open_questions: SQL Store adapter and Path C consumer still open.
Human maintainer review pending; retain CANDIDATE.
